New Zealand Cricketers Ruled Out of India Series Due to Injury

New Zealand cricketers Will O'Rourke, Michael Chapman, and Scott Kuggeleijn have been ruled out of the upcoming T20 series against India due to injuries. O'Rourke will miss the 2026 series due to hamstring and calf injuries sustained during the test series win over England in June. Chapman and Kuggeleijn are also unavailable for the T20 series against India.
